title: Command Palette doesn't store results ordering.
author: denismattos

judgment.rationale: The reporter explicitly says the restart-ordering symptom appears fixed after updating to 0.101.2362.0. The related newly-installed-app discovery observation is not proven to be the same defect and should not keep this resolved report open as a duplicate design.
evidence: The original report says selection promotion was lost after PowerToys or Windows restart.
On 2026-09-02 the reporter said the issue appears fixed with 0.101.2362.0.
Current Command Palette code has a RunHistoryService that reads persisted run history and a MainListRanker that uses frecency as a bounded ordering signal.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a closure comment referencing the reporter's current-version confirmation and invite a separately reproducible new-app-discovery report if that behavior persists.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reporter's current-build confirmation resolves the reported restart-ordering symptom; no competing code plan is warranted.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette had appeared to lose learned application ordering after restarts, but the reporter now says the behavior is fixed in 0.101.2362.0.
known_information: The ordering changed during a session and reset after restart on the original build.
A commenter reported a separate symptom involving newly installed applications.
The reporter confirmed an apparent resolution on the newer release.
inferences: The separate discovery symptom may be independent and requires its own current-version reproduction.
issue_context.analysis: The latest reporter activity is decisive and supersedes the earlier open defect evidence. Closing this report avoids conflating it with the separate app-discovery observation.
initial_investigation: Read the issue body and all four comments, including linked issue 41533.
Inspected current Command Palette history and ranking code.
Reviewed the linked prior-report context; no live duplicate requiring consolidation was identified.

comment.body: Thanks for confirming that the restart-ordering behavior no longer reproduces on PowerToys 0.101.2362.0. Based on that current-version result, this report can be closed as resolved. The separately mentioned case where a newly installed application is not discovered until first launch is not established as the same issue; please open or link a focused current-version report if it still reproduces.
